changes.reason: Introduce resource-snapshot sitemap generation, authenticated report/publication endpoints and local or existing StorageProvider XML writes under an explicit shared POSIX publication boundary. Pure validation/partition logic is reused across those writers; no GSC, warehouse or SSR dependency is introduced.

kubernetes.reason: The Node HTTP test reads a completed filesystem generation through real local sockets. Kubernetes uses the existing Node Host; no new cluster resource or runtime enum is introduced.
constraints: All writers for one site and tenant must share one persistent coherent POSIX directory and object namespace. Local Node evidence is not a live Kubernetes or storage-provider certification.
Crash locks fail closed and require operator inspection; publication is process-atomic rather than power-loss durable.

evidence.testName: Sitemap serves actual local HTTP XML/robots and enforces server actor, tenant, permission, origin, revision and idempotency

aws-lambda.reason: The Node coordinator can only be reused when every Lambda writer has the same persistent POSIX mount; ordinary invocation-local /tmp cannot coordinate durable publication.
constraints: Requires an application-owned shared persistent POSIX mount, bounded snapshot/memory/execution budgets, coherent read-after-write objects and awaited work before invocation completion.
No live Lambda/EFS execution or certification is claimed.

cloudflare.reason: The publication coordinator uses node:fs and POSIX rename/locking; Worker isolates have no shared persistent POSIX filesystem. Existing Workers rendering support is unchanged.
constraints: Generate artifacts in a Node build environment or separately evaluate an explicit Node Container with shared persistent storage. No Worker or Node Container publication support is certified.
